title: Field Operational Docket: Applied ML research brief — quantization, evals, onboarding
body:
Meeting: Applied ML field sync — midweek capture (notes & actions)
Date: 2027-03-31
Facilitator: Eleanor Park
Attendees: Eleanor, Rajat, Sofia, Marta (+ async notes from Kevin)

Purpose: quick status capture across three converging threads: compact quantization probes, eval pipeline drift signals, and friction points in the model-onboarding checklist. Aim is to have a short, actionable docket to carry into Thurs eng triage.

1) Compact quant probes (status, recent runs)
- Summary: Ran micro-bench suite on 4bit KV-prefetch builds (kv4bit-v2) across gpt-style LLaMA forks. Observed consistent ~1.9x token throughput improvement on p4d during microbatch=8 with minimal top-1 generation quality regressions on short-completion tasks.
- Notable anomaly: translation prompts with repeated numeric tokens show perplexity spike in 4/40 seeds (seed variance appears correlated with weight clipping threshold).
- Quick numbers (median across 10 seeds):
  - baseline float16 throughput: 120 tokens/s
  - kv4bit-v2 throughput: 230 tokens/s
  - avg latency p50: baseline 42ms -> kv4bit 28ms
  - eval BLEU-like proxy on small translation set: baseline 0.81 -> kv4bit 0.78 (drop concentrated in numerical fidelity examples)
- Hypothesis: KV cache quantization combined with the current rotary embedding rescale interacts poorly with repeated numerics.
- Immediate next steps:
  - Rajat: run targeted ablation toggling rotary rescale and weight-clipping (JIRA-ML-8342) (ETA 48h).
  - Marta: add 200 synthetic numeric-heavy examples to eval harness; mark as "sensitive" category.

2) Eval pipeline drift & signal hygiene
- Summary: New production harness (v2-eval) started flagging more false positives when comparing model variants due to tiny distributional shifts in prompt tokenization (tokenizer update from upstream). Many earlier smoke tests passed; regression alerts increased by ~17% last 7 days.
- Root causes identified so far:
  - tokenizer token-id remapping for special tokens (upstream change)
  - small prompt formatting normalization done in client-side quick scripts (uncommitted local change)
- Actions:
  - Sofia: pin tokenizer pkg to upstream hash used in baseline (done in sandbox, will open PR to freeze in Docker images) (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/quant-bench/pull/214).
  - Eleanor: add normalization step in eval harness that strips zero-width spaces and normalizes unicode numerals (todo: add unit tests).
- Policy note: add a short checklist item to onboarding runbook: "verify tokenizer hash + normalization script included in release bundle". Link: confluence.redwood.com/display/ML/Model-Onboard-Runbook

3) Model onboarding friction log (customer-facing models + internal catalog)
- Observations: Two models in onboarding queue hit issues: one due to incompatible attention kernel (opset mismatch on A100), another due to licensing metadata missing (we detected GPL-3 artifact in dependency tree).
- Actions & owners:
  - Kevin (async): finalize kernel-compat shim for the attention op by EOD Fri (temporary shim that maps op signatures).
  - Eleanor: coordinate legal flag for dependency; reach out to licensing@redwood and add a hold in catalog until resolved.

4) Short-term experiment requests (triage)
- Request A: Low-latency batcher experiment — try microbatching threshold heuristic that switches between continuous batching vs immediate dispatch at tail-latency>200ms. (Owner: Rajat; sample config in linked PR).
- Request B: Precision-conditional rerank test — use float16 for generation, int8 for candidate embedding recompute to save memory on rerank pipeline. (Owner: Sofia; bench ETA 72h).

5) Blockers / risks
- Non-deterministic seed sensitivity in kv4bit runs (makes CI flaky). Risk: false-positive rollouts if we don't surface seed variance. Mitigation: add seed-variance checks and require delta significance > 2 sigma across seeds before marking regression.
- Legal hold on one onboarding artifact (blocking release to prod catalog).

6) Quick decision log
- Decide to hold kv4bit-v2 rollouts to Dedicated until numeric-fidelity patch landed. Temporary: enable fallback routing to kv8 variant for customers on numeric-sensitive workloads.
- Approve freezing tokenizer dependency in all eval harness images until further notice.

7) Unresolved questions / open threads
- Are we comfortable with the current definition of "numeric fidelity" in our eval suite? Proposal: add metric that explicitly measures number-exactness (digits, dates, identifiers) across outputs. (Assigned to Marta for proposal).
- Should rollouts include a seed-variance threshold in the automated canary gate? (Discuss Thurs eng triage).

8) Action items (short list)
- Rajat: ablation for rotary rescale + weight clipping (48h).
- Marta: augment eval set with numeric category + draft metric for numeric fidelity (72h).
- Sofia: open PR to pin tokenizer hash and add normalization (24h).
- Eleanor: coordinate licensing inquiry + add hold; add onboarding checklist item (48h).
- Kevin: attention-kernel shim (EOD Fri).

Notes to self: keep an eye on the false-positive curve from v2-eval; if alerts > 25% increase re-open signal triage and consider rolling back to v1 harness.

Attachments: pasted small bench outputs, link to bench logs, and a short sample of the failing numeric prompts (copied below).

Sample failing prompts (numeric edgecases):
- "Convert 1,234.00 to cents and summarize the transaction."
- "Invoice #00012345: list line-items and total; preserve leading zeros."
- "Date parsing check: 03/04/05 — interpret as yyyy-mm-dd or dd-mm-yy? Provide canonical form."

End of docket.

Follow-up sync: Thurs 10:00am — brief triage + roll call. If urgent, ping on #applied-ml-ops.
